summary: Context.dev's free tier includes 1,000 API credits per month (a standard scrape starts at 1 credit; extraction/brand calls cost more) plus a separate one-time 10K Logo Link quota — no credit card required. The Free plan currently permits 2 concurrent core API requests per organization and 10 requests per minute across a new account’s API keys. Existing accounts keep their allowances until they change plans, and custom overrides may apply; check the dashboard for effective limits.

social_proof.text: The free tier includes 1,000 API credits per month, plus 10K one-time Logo Link requests, with no credit card required. Core API: Free allows 2 concurrent requests; new Free accounts also allow 10 requests per minute across their API keys.
